summary: Evolution Petroleum Corp, through its subsidiary Evolution Minerals LLC, entered a Purchase and Sale Agreement to acquire mineral, royalty, and overriding royalty interests in Midland Basin oil and gas properties across five Texas counties. The all-cash consideration is $16,000,000, subject to customary adjustments, with closing expected on or about August 21, 2026, and an effective date of August 1, 2026. The seller must first acquire the assets under an Upstream Acquisition Agreement; Evolution may terminate if that fails. The acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions, with mutual indemnification provisions. Watch for timely closing and any regulatory or title issues.
